rationale: C18 provides a highly specific drafting template: both directives begin by excepting a quoted statutory provision, then suspend the remaining personnel-promotion provisions, and use the identical endpoint tied to June 30 of the fiscal year following the end of the December 16, 1950 national emergency. C03 and C20 share the same suspension machinery and emergency-linked endpoint but lack C18's especially distinctive quoted-exception structure.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Except as to the provisions which read, [quoted provision] ... the provisions of section 5764 (a) ... are hereby suspended until June 30 of the fiscal year following that in which the national emergency proclaimed by [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] of December 16, 1950, shall end.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Except as to the provision which reads, [quoted provision] ... the operation of the provisions of paragraph (2) of section 308 (b) ... is hereby suspended until June 30 of the fiscal year following that in which the national emergency proclaimed by [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] of December 16, 1950, shall end.
shared_material.explanation: The child closely reproduces C18's unusual sequence and language: a quoted carve-out introduced by “Except as to,” identification of the remaining naval promotion statute, suspension, and the same emergency-dependent termination formula.
